summons.name: Owl (Familiar)
summons.notes: A tiny familiar conjured by find familiar. Flying speed 60 ft. Flyby (no opportunity attacks when it flies out of reach), keen hearing and sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

summons.name: Cat (Familiar)
summons.notes: A nimble familiar. Keen smell; climbing speed 30 ft.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee attack, +0 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

summons.name: Wolf
summons.notes: Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks against a creature if an ally is within 5 ft of it. Keen hearing and smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2d4+2 piercing. If the target is a creature it must succeed on a DC 11 STR save or be knocked prone.

summons.name: Black Bear
summons.notes: Keen smell; climbing speed 30 ft. Multiattack: one bite and one claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d6+2 piercing.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2d4+2 slashing.

summons.name: Giant Spider
summons.notes: Climbing speed 30 ft; spider climb and web sense/walker. Can shoot a web to restrain a target (DC 11 DEX save, Recharge 5–6).

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8+3 piercing, plus 2d8 poison on a failed DC 11 CON save (half on success; reduced to 0 HP at 0 is paralyzed).

summons.name: Skeleton
summons.notes: Undead. Vulnerable to bludgeoning; immune to poison and exhaustion; obeys its raiser's commands.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d6+2 piercing.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320. Hit: 1d6+2 piercing.
